title: Una sociedad de castas
goal: Read about the elaborate colonial racial-classification system and the strange 18th-century painting genre that tried to make it look orderly.
grammar: Se pasiva / impersonal: la sociedad de castas

items: Name several casta terms and explain what they classified.
Explain why the system was applied inconsistently in practice.
Describe what casta paintings were and how they were organized.
Explain what the paintings reveal, without meaning to, about colonial society.
Use se-passive/impersonal constructions to describe a sustained classification system.
